title: Shifted binomial probability asymptotics
statement: For fixed natural numbers $c$ and $j$ with $j\le c$, let $P_m=\binom{2m+c}{m+j}/2^{2m+c}$ and $I_m=\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$. As $m\to\infty$, the ratio $P_m/I_m$ tends to $1$.
